title: Audit of c14's pcell-mwall-b42 (SIBDH): all five capabilities are produced by the dynamics; a neutral-trait twin (ytrait=2) freezes into static cells with 0 splits and 0 deaths on 2/2 fresh seeds; remnant double counts inflate raw deaths 1.3-2.8x but yield-biased lineage deaths survive on 7/7 seeds and at 1.5x resolution
summary: Construction: world.py has no division, death or trait-keyed rule; the trait y scales a particle's link production at no cost and is capped at an imposed 1.2; the M layer is placed by an adsorption drift written against phi, but the cells make 97.5% of M (msource.py), so B counts under the quasi-equilibrium clause and does no work. World-level control on fresh seeds 10 and 11: the claim arm gives 9/11 persistent splits (generation 3/4), 14/12 mature lineage deaths at the 1.8th/1.4th yield percentile (marker 46th/54th) and ybar - zbar = +0.17/+0.17; the neutral twin (y inherited and mutated, every particle acting with y0) has 0 splits, 0 mature deaths and ybar - zbar = -0.02/+0.07, so births and deaths are both caused by the evolving trait (at y=1 the world is static). A remnant-aware lineage count (physlineage.py) removes 6-41 double-counted deaths per run, and every remaining mature death is below the median yield on the claim's seeds 0-3 and my seeds 8, 10, 11. The yield rise is between cells (Price +0.19/+0.16, within -0.05/+0.01), split heritability r 0.93-0.99. At 1.5x resolution (scale 1.5, 192^2, seed 10): 9 persistent splits, generation 5, 7 mature deaths at the 4.8th percentile (marker 55th), ybar - zbar +0.13, M rim/core 3.50.

verdicts.limitation: Raw genealogy deaths are inflated 1.3-2.8x by remnants of shrinking cells that are recorded dead and reappear; the claim's death counts and its low-born/high-born fate table rest on them, though the yield bias of lineage deaths survives. D exists only because the trait evolves: at the starting yield the b=0.042 world is static, b having been tuned to the imposed cap 1.2, and the trait has no cost. M does no work. The marker mutates with independent draws (matched, not identical-event). Mature lineage deaths per seed are few (6-14). No dt test (rates are per step). The seed-11 twin's mean y drifts 0.07 from its marker by neutral drift.
